about.title: About Me
about.content: I am an IT and data professional with experience spanning software quality assurance, data analytics, technical support, and business operations. My work focuses on translating requirements into reliable systems, transforming data into actionable insights, identifying quality issues, and supporting organizations through structured technology solutions. I am currently pursuing a Doctor of Computer Science, building on graduate training in Information Technology and a professional background across consulting, analytics, IT support, and organizational operations.

experience.page_subtitle: A track record across software quality assurance, data analytics, technical support, and organizational operations.

featured_work.title: National Startup Capital Readiness Scoring (NSCRS) Platform
featured_work.summary: Product validation and quality assurance support for the National Startup Capital Readiness Scoring (NSCRS) Platform — an AI-powered system that evaluates startup funding readiness using approximately 25 indicators across six areas, producing a Capital Readiness Score, AI analysis, and actionable recommendations for founders.
highlights: Validated end-to-end assessment flows from founder intake through score generation and recommendation delivery.
Tested scoring consistency across approximately 25 indicators grouped into six readiness areas, including edge cases and output clarity.
Reviewed capital readiness scorecards, AI narrative evaluation, and founder-facing recommendation modules before release.
Logged and retested product defects related to scoring logic, result presentation, and assessment workflows.

roles.summary: Supported software quality assurance, testing, defect management, and cross-functional software delivery.
responsibilities: Designed and executed 150+ manual and automated test cases covering functional, regression, system, and user acceptance requirements.
Identified, documented, and tracked 60+ software defects and quality issues through resolution and retesting.
Supported testing and quality assurance activities across 15+ software releases and sprint cycles.
Collaborated with 5+ cross-functional team members including developers, project managers, and IT professionals.
Translated technical and business requirements into structured test scenarios and validation procedures.
Performed regression testing following software changes to verify fixes and reduce recurring defects.

roles.summary: Analyzed datasets, performed data-quality validation, and developed business-facing analytical insights.
responsibilities: Cleaned, validated, and analyzed 5,000+ records across 20+ datasets.
Used SQL, Python, Excel, and data-validation techniques to prepare information for analysis and reporting.
Produced 25+ analytical reports, summaries, and data-driven recommendations.
Conducted exploratory and trend analysis across local, national, and global datasets.
Performed recurring data-quality assessments to identify inconsistencies, missing values, and anomalies.
Translated complex analytical findings into clear insights for organizational stakeholders.

roles.company: Washington University of Science and Technology
roles.summary: Provided frontline technology support to students, staff, and faculty across academic and administrative environments.
responsibilities: Provided technical support to 100+ students, faculty, and staff.
Resolved or supported 250+ hardware, software, connectivity, and account-access issues.
Installed, configured, maintained, or troubleshot 75+ computers and related devices.
Completed 20+ software installations, upgrades, and system configurations.
Supported institutional data-security practices and user-access procedures.
Maintained technical records and escalated complex issues where necessary.

roles.summary: Managed core HR operations, recruitment, workforce administration, and employee support.
responsibilities: Managed HR administration and employee-support activities for 25+ employees.
Supported recruitment and onboarding of 15+ employees.
Screened, interviewed, or coordinated assessments for 30+ candidates.
Supported staffing requirements across 4+ functional teams.
Maintained employee records, HR documentation, and personnel information.
Served as a liaison between management and employees on workplace and staffing matters.

publications.page_subtitle: Peer-reviewed and journal publications on predictive analytics, AI-enabled capital readiness, and intelligent systems for startups and small enterprises.

items.title: AI-Based Predictive Capital Optimization Framework for U.S. Renewable Energy Startups: Evaluating Economic Value, Investment Efficiency, and Return on Investment
items.abstract: Presents an AI-based predictive capital optimization framework for U.S. renewable energy startups, evaluating economic value, investment efficiency, and return on investment.

items.title: AI-Powered Cybersecurity Readiness and Innovation Performance in Startup Ecosystems: A Framework for Sustainable Entrepreneurial Growth and Business Operations
items.abstract: Proposes a framework linking AI-powered cybersecurity readiness with innovation performance to support sustainable entrepreneurial growth and business operations in startup ecosystems.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence and Economic Resilience: A Review of Predictive Financial Modelling for Post-Pandemic Recovery in the United States SME Sector
items.journal_or_conference: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology, 10(7)
items.abstract: Reviews how AI-driven predictive financial modelling can support economic resilience and post-pandemic recovery among U.S. small and medium-sized enterprises.

items.title: Optimizing Capital Deployment in Post-Pandemic America: AI-Powered Predictive Analytics for Startup Resilience and Growth
items.journal_or_conference: International Journal of Computer Applications Technology and Research
items.abstract: Examines AI-powered predictive analytics for capital deployment, helping startups forecast capital needs, identify opportunities, and strengthen resilience in the post-pandemic U.S. economy.

items.title: Predictive Financial Technologies for Strengthening Liquidity and Cash-Flow Management in U.S. Small Enterprises
items.journal_or_conference: Frontiers in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, 5(4)
items.abstract: Analyzes predictive financial technologies that help U.S. small enterprises improve liquidity visibility, cash-flow planning, and operational sustainability.

items.title: AI at Scale: Predictive Analytics as a Strategic Engine for National Competitiveness in U.S. Startup and Small Business Financing
items.journal_or_conference: International Journal of Research Publication and Reviews, 5(12)
items.abstract: Explores how large-scale predictive analytics can improve transparency, capital allocation, and competitiveness in U.S. startup and small business financing.
